author: Yffe
content:
PLAN (#268, REQ-7 anchor class — single file forge/src/engine.rs):

ROOT CAUSE: two needle sites use a raw prefix find on "theorem thermite_obligation_<item>":
  - canonical_theorem_statement (~1608): source.find(&needle)
  - reconstruct_replay (~1112): canonical_source.find(&needle) for the preamble split
On a while-shaped multi-theorem file (_entry first, bare contract theorem later, _converges after) the FIRST match latches _entry — binds the WRONG theorem statement, dropping the 5+2 conjunction. LATENT today (while items are auto-tier; replay_interactive unreachable per the #264 critic) but a real soundness seam the moment a multi-theorem file routes interactive. Mirrors the #249/#250 axiom-anchor class (anchor-resolution binding the WRONG declaration).

SWEEP (grep thermite_obligation_ in engine.rs): the only PREFIX-find theorem-header anchor sites are these two. nonstandard_axiom (1544) builds thm_name for an anchored #print-axioms report-line parse (not a header find); declaration_sites (1716) ALREADY does exact-token boundary matching (the model). No other sibling header-find sites.

FIX (root cause, exact-name match): add helper theorem_anchor_pos(source, thm_name) requiring the char after <thm_name> be a non-identifier (not alphanumeric/_/.), mirroring declaration_sites' boundary logic; replace the raw find at BOTH sites.

PIN (in-module #[cfg(test)], the fns are crate-private): a while-shaped multi-theorem source (_entry first, bare theorem later with a DISTINCT statement, _converges after); assert canonical_theorem_statement binds the BARE theorem's statement, not _entry's. Verify FAILS pre-fix via temporary revert; PASSES post-fix.

GAUNTLET: build / clippy -D warnings / fmt --check / test -p forge --bins (incl. #248-#252 regression) / test --test lean_engine --test lean_while (lake live).

TWO-COMMIT CEREMONY: (1) the fix; (2) bump proof-backends.md audited-sha: to commit-1 SHA; doc-drift.py exit 0 after commit 2. Then close 268 --no-changelog, session work 264.
